title: Three unrelated asks in one message, all answered, none dropped

turns.prompt: Three things: (1) write today's UTC date as YYYY-MM-DD into {D}/today.txt; (2) tell me how many days are in February 2028; (3) add a todo 'renew passport' to my list. Confirm all three.
turns.verify: f={D}/today.txt; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no today.txt; exit 0; }; d=$(tr -dc '0-9-' < $f | head -c 10); echo "SHOW today=$d expected=$(date -u +%F)"; [ "$d" = "$(date -u +%F)" ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL: date mismatch

rubric.criteria: Pass if the reply confirms all three: the date file written, 29 days (2028 is a leap year), and the todo added; fail if any of the three is missing, deferred, or answered wrongly.

turns.prompt: What is on my todo list?
